steps: Make a payment of ₹2,400 to your HDFC Millennia card.

top_actions.title: Dispute the Collection
top_actions.why: You have a disputable collection of ₹890 from Airtel Postpaid that can potentially recover 20-50 points if successfully disputed.
steps: File a written dispute with CIBIL and the other 3 bureaus via their online dispute portal.
Ensure that the creditor verifies the collection within 30 days; if not, it must be removed.
Do not contact the collection agency directly; always dispute in writing.

top_actions.title: Place a Credit Freeze
top_actions.why: You have 3 hard inquiries in the last 6 months, which can negatively impact your score. A credit freeze will prevent further inquiries.
steps: Immediately place a credit freeze at all 4 bureaus: CIBIL, Experian, Equifax, and CRIF High Mark.
Do not apply for any new credit for at least 12 months to let existing inquiries age out.
If you need to apply for a loan, ensure to do so within a 14-day window to minimize impact.
top_actions.when_youll_see_results: After 6-12 months as inquiries fade in impact

what_to_avoid: Do not apply for any new credit for the next 12 months to avoid additional inquiries.
Avoid making late payments, as your payment history is currently perfect.
Do not ignore the collection; disputing it can significantly improve your score.
